description: Two LFOs whose rate, shape, amplitude, phase and duty cycle you set, with a trigger sent out each time their two outputs cross

params.text: Sets the master frequency both LFOs run from, 0 to 10; each LFO's rate knob multiplies this, so the pair hold their ratio as this moves, and the freq input adds to it
Multiplies the master frequency to set this LFO's rate, 0 to 10: at 1 it runs at the master frequency and at 0.5 at half of it
Sets this LFO's amplitude, 0 to 1, reaching ±5V at its output with the knob fully clockwise
Sweeps this LFO's waveform through sine at 0, triangle at 1, sawtooth at 2 and rectangle at 3, blending between each neighbouring pair in between
Offsets this LFO's phase by up to a whole cycle, 0 to 1
Sets the duty cycle of the rectangle wave, 0 to 1 with 0.5 giving equal halves, and makes no difference to a shape setting below 2
Scales the voltage at this row's rate input before it is added to the rate knob, -1 to 1: it inverts below zero and passes nothing at the centre
Scales the voltage at this row's amt input before it is added to the amount knob, -1 to 1: it inverts below zero and passes nothing at the centre
Scales the voltage at this row's shape input before it is added to the shape knob, -1 to 1: it inverts below zero and passes nothing at the centre

inputs.text: Added straight to the freq knob, one step of that knob's 0 to 10 range per volt, with no attenuator of its own
Adds to this row's rate knob after the small knob on that row scales it; 10V through an attenuverter at 1 adds one step to the rate knob
Adds to this row's shape knob after the small knob on that row scales it; 10V through an attenuverter at 1 moves the shape by one step
Adds to this row's amount knob after the small knob on that row scales it, and the total is held between 0 and 1
Restarts both LFOs at the start of their cycle on each rising edge above 0V

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse at 10V each time the two LFO outputs cross
The first LFO, ±5V with its amount knob fully clockwise
The second LFO, ±5V with its amount knob fully clockwise
The first LFO minus the second, ±10V at full amplitude, passing through 0V at the instant a trigger is sent

notes: the knobs and the five CV inputs are read once every four samples, while the LFOs themselves run at every sample
an amount knob at zero holds that LFO flat at 0V, and crossings stop while it is there, so no triggers come out
